== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[The Way]] Between [[Worlds]], also referred to as Way{{!}}the Way or the [[Dreamway]], is a fundamental force of pure order that holds reality in place. It manifests as an endless expanse of blue light, often described as a [[sapphire]]-colored space or a textured tunnel resembling a mix of cloth and light. Visually, it can appear as a map consisting of a central blue core with branching rivers of light that connect various points known as [[Iterations]], which resemble small white berries hanging from branches. This cosmic structure serves as a medium for communication among the [[Abidan]] and allows for travel between different worlds, though navigating it can be unpredictable and may result in travelers being shunted to unintended locations. [[The Way]] functions as a connective web for the cosmos, though it is susceptible to corruption and instability. Some [[Iterations]] have been lost to gray corruption, shattered, or stolen by the [[Vroshir]]. Certain entities, such as those from the [[Vroshir]] homeworlds, can use their presence to tether worlds more tightly to Way{{!}}the Way. While it facilitates movement and information sharing, the connection can become thin or unstable in certain sectors; for instance, the connection near [[Cradle]] has grown weak and gray due to [[Vroshir]] influence. Additionally, specialized areas like the [[Dreamway]] function as a massive repository of knowledge within Way{{!}}the Way.}}
